source: curated by hand (2026-11-03, mcp-server.md §12.9) from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on windows, 2026-11-03 and the evidence listed
summary: Stereo multi-tap delay: per track a left and right line with tap level, pans, feedback (optionally ping-pong) and stereo spread, plus a filter on the echoes. For dub echoes and wide, filtered delays.
quirks: Stereo in and out; each track is a tap (4 at most).
Lengths count in Delay unit: ticks (the default, so echoes follow the tempo), 1/256 ticks, samples or ms.
The filter's coefficients assume 44.1 kHz (its source), so at other sample rates its cutoff moves with the rate.
FB Amp at its top (−0.1 dB) piles up: +10.5 dBFS after 30 s in the profile.
evidence: ExternalMachines/source/buzztrax-buzzmachines/FSM/PanzerDelay/PanzerDelay.cpp — parameter table, DescribeValue (dB, pans, spread), TickTrack, the filter
profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-03) — delay, 6 echoes from 375 ms, hot with FB Amp at its top

problems: hot (loud but steady) with Wet L Pan at its minimum (100% L): +0.3 dBFS peak; Wet R Pan at its maximum (100% R): +1.0 dBFS peak; FB Amp at its maximum (-0.1 dB): +10.5 dBFS peak over 30 s

swept_because: an effect with Resonance, FB Amp, FB PingPong, FB Spread

parameters.name: Dry amp
parameters.description: Level of the dry signal, −24 to 0 dB (raw 0: off).

parameters.name: Dry L Pan
parameters.description: Where the dry left channel goes: −100% left to +100% right (raw 120: centre).

parameters.name: Dry R Pan
parameters.description: Where the dry right channel goes: −100% left to +100% right.

parameters.name: Filter type
parameters.description: None, low-pass, high-pass or band-pass on the echoes.

track_parameters.description: In Delay unit (3 ticks by default).

track_parameters.description: Level of this tap, −24 to 0 dB (raw 0: off).

track_parameters.name: Wet L Pan
track_parameters.description: Where this tap's left echo goes, −100% left to +100% right.

track_parameters.name: Wet R Pan
track_parameters.description: Where this tap's right echo goes, −100% left to +100% right.

track_parameters.name: FB Amp
